from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
programs = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    separator_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background]
    separator_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != background]
    row_edges = [-1] + separator_rows + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + separator_cols + [w]
    row_regions = [(row_edges[i] + 1, row_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_edges) - 1)]
    col_regions = [(col_edges[i] + 1, col_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_edges) - 1)]
    source = None
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_regions):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_regions):
            if any(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)):
                source = (ri, ci, r0, r1, c0, c1)
                break
        if source is not None:
            break
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    _, _, sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = source
    tile = [grid[r][sc0:sc1] for r in range(sr0, sr1)]
    for r0, r1 in row_regions:
        for c0, c1 in col_regions:
            for dr, r in enumerate(range(r0, r1)):
                for dc, c in enumerate(range(c0, c1)):
                    out[r][c] = tile[dr][dc]
    return out
'''
path = programs / 'task-bb214fc7.py'
path.write_text(code)
# Check against demo output and generate test output
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog', path)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
demo = [[6,3,3,3,7,3,2,3,3,3,3,3,3],[3,7,6,3,3,6,2,3,3,3,3,3,3],[3,3,3,3,3,0,2,3,3,3,3,3,3],[3,3,3,7,3,3,2,3,3,3,3,3,3],[3,7,3,3,9,3,2,3,3,3,3,3,3],[2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2],[3,3,3,3,3,3,2,3,3,3,3,3,3],[3,3,3,3,3,3,2,3,3,3,3,3,3],[3,3,3,3,3,3,2,3,3,3,3,3,3],[3,3,3,3,3,3,2,3,3,3,3,3,3],[3,3,3,3,3,3,2,3,3,3,3,3,3]]
expected = [[6,3,3,3,7,3,2,6,3,3,3,7,3],[3,7,6,3,3,6,2,3,7,6,3,3,6],[3,3,3,3,3,0,2,3,3,3,3,3,0],[3,3,3,7,3,3,2,3,3,3,7,3,3],[3,7,3,3,9,3,2,3,7,3,3,9,3],[2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2],[6,3,3,3,7,3,2,6,3,3,3,7,3],[3,7,6,3,3,6,2,3,7,6,3,3,6],[3,3,3,3,3,0,2,3,3,3,3,3,0],[3,3,3,7,3,3,2,3,3,3,7,3,3],[3,7,3,3,9,3,2,3,7,3,3,9,3]]
print('demo reproduces:', mod.transform(demo) == expected)
test = [[5,5,5,5,3,5,5,5,5,3,5,5,5,5] for _ in range(5)] + [[3]*14] + [[5,5,5,5,3,5,5,5,5,3,6,0,9,9],[5,5,5,5,3,5,5,5,5,3,6,1,5,5],[5,5,5,5,3,5,5,5,5,3,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,3,5,5,5,5,3,5,1,0,9],[5,5,5,5,3,5,5,5,5,3,5,5,6,5]]
